description: Passes a damaged, missing, wrong or late IMPOSSIBREW order to the support team as a case, with any details the customer gives. It does not issue refunds, credits or replacements; the support team decides and replies by email. The message goes to the AI Brewer, the same assistant as on impossibrew.co.uk, which checks identity (email plus delivery postcode, or an order number starting EC plus either). message is the customer's own words. The first call has no conversationId; each result returns the conversationId that continues the same conversation across these order tools. The reply is the AI Brewer's complete answer.
name: report_order_problem
title: Report an order problem
